1: // Minimal Endless Runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (function(){
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
8: 
9:   // Starfield data
10:   const STAR_COUNT = 120;
11:   const stars = [];
12:   for(let i=0;i<STAR_COUNT;i++){
13:     stars.push({
14:       x: Math.random()*W,
15:       y: Math.random()*H,
16:       z: Math.random() // depth factor 0..1
17:     });
18:   }
19: 
20:   function updateStars(dt){
21:     const speed = 0.03 * dt; // adjust for smoothness
22:     for(const s of stars){
23:       s.x -= speed * (1 + s.z*2);
24:       if(s.x < 0) s.x += W;
25:     }
26:   }
27: 
28:   function drawStars(){
29:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
30:     for(const s of stars){
31:       const size = 1 + s.z*2;
32:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, size, size);
33:     }
34:   }
35: 
36:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
37:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
38:   function beep(freq, duration){
39:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
40:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
41:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
42:     osc.type = 'sine';
43:     osc.connect(gain);
44:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
45:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
46:     osc.start();
47:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
48:   }
49:   function playThrust(){ beep(400, 0.08); }
50:   function playCollision(){ beep(150, 0.4); }
51:   // simple background hum loop
52:   function startBackground(){
53:     setInterval(()=>{ beep(200, 0.2); }, 3000);
54:   }
55:   startBackground();
56: 
57:   // Rocket
58:   const rocket = {x: W*0.2, y: H/2, w:20, h:30, vy:0};
59:   const GRAVITY = 0.4;
60:   const THRUST = -8;
61: 
62:   // Obstacles
63:   const obstacles = [];
64:   const OBSTACLE_W = 30;
65:   const OBSTACLE_GAP = 150;
66:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
67:   let lastSpawn = 0;
68: 
69:   // Score
70:   let score = 0;
71:   let gameOver = false;
72: 
73:   function reset(){
74:     rocket.y = H/2; rocket.vy = 0; obstacles.length=0; score=0; lastSpawn=0; gameOver=false;
75:   }
76: 
77:   function spawn(){
78:     const gapY = Math.random() * (H - OBSTACLE_GAP - 40) + 20;
79:     obstacles.push({x:W, y:0, w:OBSTACLE_W, h:gapY}); // top
80:     obstacles.push({x:W, y:gapY+OBSTACLE_GAP, w:OBSTACLE_W, h:H-(gapY+OBSTACLE_GAP)}); // bottom
81:   }
82: 
83:   function update(dt){
84:     if(gameOver) return;
85:     // rocket physics
86:     rocket.vy += GRAVITY;
87:     rocket.y += rocket.vy;
88:     // boundaries
89:     if(rocket.y < 0 || rocket.y + rocket.h > H) gameOver = true;
90:     // obstacles move
91:     for(let i=obstacles.length-1;i>=0;i--){
92:       const o = obstacles[i];
93:       o.x -= dt * 0.2; // speed
94:       // collision
95:       if(o.x < rocket.x+rocket.w && o.x+o.w > rocket.x &&
96:          o.y < rocket.y+rocket.h && o.y+o.h > rocket.y){
97:         gameOver = true; break;
98:       }
99:       // remove off‑screen
100:       if(o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i,1);
101:     }
102:     // spawn new obstacles
103:     if(Date.now() - lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL){
104:       spawn();
105:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
106:     }
107:     // score based on time
108:     score = Math.floor((Date.now()-startTime)/100);
109:   }
110: 
111: function draw(dt){
112:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
113:     // background gradient
114:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
115:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001a33');
116:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
117:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
118:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
119:     // starfield
120:     updateStars(dt);
121:     drawStars();
122:     // rocket with thrust flame
123:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
124:     ctx.beginPath();
125:     ctx.moveTo(rocket.x, rocket.y);
126:     ctx.lineTo(rocket.x, rocket.y+rocket.h);
127:     ctx.lineTo(rocket.x+rocket.w, rocket.y+rocket.h/2);
128:     ctx.closePath();
129:     ctx.fill();
130:     // flame when thrusting
131:     if(rocket.vy < 0){
132:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
133:       ctx.beginPath();
134:       ctx.moveTo(rocket.x, rocket.y+rocket.h/2);
135:       ctx.lineTo(rocket.x-10, rocket.y+rocket.h/2+5);
136:       ctx.lineTo(rocket.x, rocket.y+rocket.h/2+10);
137:       ctx.closePath();
138:       ctx.fill();
139:     }
140:     // obstacles as dark rectangles with slight gradient
141:     obstacles.forEach(o=>{
142:       const obsGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(o.x,0,o.x+o.w,0);
143:       obsGrad.addColorStop(0,'#333');
144:       obsGrad.addColorStop(1,'#111');
145:       ctx.fillStyle = obsGrad;
146:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
147:     });
148:     // score
149:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
150:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
151:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+score, 10, 20);
152:     if(gameOver){
153:       ctx.fillStyle = 'yellow';
154:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
155:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W/2-60, H/2);
156:     }
157:   }
158:   }
159: 
160:   let startTime = Date.now();
161:   function loop(timestamp){
162:     const dt = timestamp - (prevTimestamp||timestamp);
163:     prevTimestamp = timestamp;
164:     update(dt);
165:     draw(dt);
166:     if(!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
167:   }
168:   let prevTimestamp;
169:   // input
170:   function thrust(){
171:     if(gameOver){reset(); startTime=Date.now(); requestAnimationFrame(loop);}
172:     else rocket.vy = THRUST;
173:   }
174:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', thrust);
175:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e=>{e.preventDefault(); thrust();});
176:   // start
177:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
178: })();
